basics.name: Wei Zhang
basics.label: M.S. Student in Computer Science
basics.summary: M.S. student in Computer Science at the University of Illinois Urbana-Champaign, advised by Prof. Fan Lai. Previously received B.S. in Computer Science from Peking University. Interested in machine learning systems, large language model serving, and scheduling for SLO-aware inference.

work.name: Tempo: SLO-aware LLM Serving System
work.summary: Built an SLO-aware LLM serving system on top of vLLM to improve responsiveness across diverse workloads.
highlights: Implemented Just-in-Time scheduling with response-length estimation and dependency tracking, reducing SLO violations by up to 6.3×.
Designed the Grouped Margin Goodput Maximization (GMAX) algorithm to balance per-request deadlines and batch efficiency, saving 28.5%–83.2% resources.

work.name: Serverless Pilot
work.summary: Developed a serverless workflow engine with DAG scheduling and pre-warming strategies under Prof. Xin Jin.
highlights: Built backend services and frontend monitoring dashboard.
Benchmarked performance across real workflows, improving stability and user experience.

work.name: PKUJarvis
work.summary: Developed a data pipeline and model-serving system for Chinese-language Q&A.
highlights: Aggregated WeChat public account data with web crawling.
Fine-tuned Llama2 and ChatGLM models to improve downstream accuracy.

projects.name: Improved Open-vocabulary Segmentation with Diffusion Models
projects.summary: Developed a fusion module combining visual and textual embeddings, improving segmentation accuracy on open-vocabulary datasets.
highlights: Implemented model training and inference in PyTorch.

projects.name: Paint Like Painters: Image-Generation with Diffusion-based Autoregressive Framework
projects.summary: Implemented an autoregressive image generation framework with diffusion-based masking.
highlights: Built training pipeline and inference engine, compared performance with one-shot diffusion baselines.
